works.title: Aura: 75+ Analysis Modes Framework
works.description: Consolidating 75+ analysis modes into an outcome-driven disambiguation design. Inspired by Newton/Leibniz philosophy of releasing work openly. User actively developing (15 hours/day), with explicit plans to publish and market this innovation stack.
works.quote: I've been so enthralled with the Aura project that I'm spending a bit too much time at the desk—probably putting in a good 15 hours a day working on it. It's been a labor of love... nobody's gonna put all 27 of them stacked together in one thing like Aura does.

works.title: The Experience of Innovation: A Memoir of Breakthrough Epiphanies
works.description: Meta-reflection documenting the felt experience of creative breakthroughs, epiphanies, and the innovation process—specifically the emotional arc of developing complex frameworks. Planned as a future book after Aura project completion, capturing moments of standing on frameworks and building higher.
works.quote: I want to document the experience of these emotional ups and downs—what it felt like to have these epiphanies, what it felt like when I realized that the epiphanies I had in the framework I created elevated me above what anybody else was doing.
